title: Introduction to Public Sector and Public Management

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the structure of the public sector and basic principles of public management.
Analyze and explain the principles of public management and organizational models for service delivery and public goods provision by the state.
Explain the functions of public management by the state over time, across different fields of impact, and at various stages of implementation.
Identify and apply key tools of public management used by the state.
Describe and apply methods and forms of public management used by the state.
Develop skills in presenting and speaking effectively.
Develop skills in working in groups, organizing and managing group work effectively, evaluating the quality of work after completion, and the results achieved by group members.
Develop skills in managing time and resources well.
Develop skills in analyzing public management problems and making decisions in public management.
Practice working independently or in groups under changing working conditions; have the ability to evaluate and improve the effectiveness of activities.
Practice guiding and supervising others to perform assigned tasks; take personal responsibility and responsibility towards the group.
Proactively identify and solve problems in practical public management and protect personal viewpoints.
Act with a spirit of service, social responsibility, and professional ethics.
Actively learn to meet job requirements and adapt to changes.
